topics.title: Understanding the task and writing with purpose

subtopics.title: Understanding the task and writing with purpose, score 3-4

outcomes.text: Write a thesis that is unclear or only loosely tied to the issue
Respond only weakly to other perspectives

subtopics.title: Understanding the task and writing with purpose, score 5-6

outcomes.text: Write a somewhat clear thesis taking a stance on a contemporary issue
Respond to other perspectives on the issue

subtopics.title: Understanding the task and writing with purpose, score 7-8

outcomes.text: Write a clear thesis taking a stance on a contemporary issue
Engage with other perspectives on the issue

subtopics.title: Understanding the task and writing with purpose, score 9-10

outcomes.text: Write a precise thesis taking a stance on a contemporary issue
Engage productively with other perspectives

subtopics.title: Understanding the task and writing with purpose, score 11-12

outcomes.text: Write a nuanced, precise thesis taking a stance on a contemporary issue
Engage critically with other perspectives

topics.title: Analyzing an issue and differing perspectives

subtopics.title: Analyzing an issue and differing perspectives, score 3-4

outcomes.text: Give analysis that is incomplete or largely irrelevant

subtopics.title: Analyzing an issue and differing perspectives, score 5-6

outcomes.text: Set up only a limited or tangential context for analysis
Give analysis that is simplistic or somewhat unclear

subtopics.title: Analyzing an issue and differing perspectives, score 7-8

outcomes.text: Set up and use a relevant context for analysis
Recognise implications, complexities, tensions, and underlying values or assumptions

subtopics.title: Analyzing an issue and differing perspectives, score 9-10

outcomes.text: Set up and use a thoughtful context for analysis
Address implications, complexities, tensions, and underlying values or assumptions

subtopics.title: Analyzing an issue and differing perspectives, score 11-12

outcomes.text: Set up and use an insightful context for analysis
Examine implications, complexities, tensions, and underlying values or assumptions

subtopics.title: Building and strengthening the argument, score 3-4

outcomes.text: Reach only a weak understanding of the issue through inadequate reasoning and examples
Offer a rationale that fails to clarify the argument
Elaborate ideas in ways that are illogical, disjointed or circular

subtopics.title: Building and strengthening the argument, score 5-6

outcomes.text: Use mostly relevant reasoning and examples to support the thesis, reaching a simple understanding
Offer a rationale that largely clarifies the argument
Elaborate ideas, though somewhat repetitively or imprecisely

subtopics.title: Building and strengthening the argument, score 7-8

outcomes.text: Use clear reasoning and examples to understand the issue and other perspectives
Convey adequately why the argument is worth considering
Extend ideas by considering factors that complicate your own view
Anticipate objections by qualifying the argument

subtopics.title: Building and strengthening the argument, score 9-10

outcomes.text: Use reasoning and examples purposefully to support the thesis and deepen understanding
Convey capably why the argument is worth considering
Enrich ideas by considering factors that complicate your own view
Anticipate objections by qualifying the argument

subtopics.title: Building and strengthening the argument, score 11-12

outcomes.text: Use reasoning and examples skilfully to broaden the context and support the thesis
Convey effectively why the argument is worth considering
Enrich and strengthen ideas by considering complicating factors
Anticipate objections by qualifying the argument

subtopics.title: Grouping and connecting ideas, score 3-4

outcomes.text: Group ideas with little consistency or clarity
Use transitions that mislead or are poorly formed

subtopics.title: Grouping and connecting ideas, score 5-6

outcomes.text: Group most ideas logically
Use transitions within and between paragraphs to clarify some relationships

subtopics.title: Grouping and connecting ideas, score 7-8

outcomes.text: Group and sequence ideas logically
Use transitions within and between paragraphs to clarify relationships

subtopics.title: Grouping and connecting ideas, score 9-10

outcomes.text: Group and sequence ideas logically to make the argument more effective
Use transitions consistently to clarify relationships among ideas

subtopics.title: Grouping and connecting ideas, score 11-12

outcomes.text: Group and sequence ideas into a progression that builds the argument
Use transitions to strengthen relationships among ideas

subtopics.title: Employing an organizational strategy, score 3-4

outcomes.text: Provide a minimal structure in which some ideas are grouped locally

subtopics.title: Employing an organizational strategy, score 5-6

outcomes.text: Provide a basic organisational structure

subtopics.title: Employing an organizational strategy, score 7-8

outcomes.text: Use an emerging controlling idea or purpose to shape the argument

subtopics.title: Employing an organizational strategy, score 9-10

outcomes.text: Use a controlling idea or purpose to unify the argument

subtopics.title: Employing an organizational strategy, score 11-12

outcomes.text: Use a controlling idea or purpose to unify and focus the argument

subtopics.title: Using language to enhance meaning, score 3-4

outcomes.text: Choose rudimentary words that are often imprecise
Make inconsistent style choices (voice, tone, diction) that do not fit the purpose

subtopics.title: Using language to enhance meaning, score 5-6

outcomes.text: Choose general words that are sometimes imprecise
Make style choices that do not always fit purpose and topic

subtopics.title: Using language to enhance meaning, score 7-8

outcomes.text: Choose adequate words that convey the argument clearly
Make style choices (voice, tone, diction) that fit purpose and topic

subtopics.title: Using language to enhance meaning, score 9-10

outcomes.text: Choose precise words that serve the argument
Make effective style choices for purpose and topic

subtopics.title: Using language to enhance meaning, score 11-12

outcomes.text: Choose skilful, precise words that strengthen the argument
Make strategic, effective style choices for purpose and topic

subtopics.title: Applying standard written English conventions, score 3-4

outcomes.text: Write sentences that only sometimes have clear structure
Write with distracting grammar, usage and mechanics errors that often obscure meaning

subtopics.title: Applying standard written English conventions, score 5-6

outcomes.text: Write sentences with usually clear but little varied structure
Write with distracting errors that mostly still convey meaning

subtopics.title: Applying standard written English conventions, score 7-8

outcomes.text: Write sentences with clear, occasionally varied structures
Write with some errors that still convey meaning clearly

subtopics.title: Applying standard written English conventions, score 9-10

outcomes.text: Write sentences with clear, often varied structures
Write with only minor grammar, usage and mechanics errors

subtopics.title: Applying standard written English conventions, score 11-12

outcomes.text: Write sentences with clear, consistently varied structures
Write free of all but a few minor errors
